responsibility: This file supplies small but central backend callbacks used directly by the shared D frontend during semantic processing and CTFE. It determines whether a function should be treated as a builtin by consulting intrinsic registration, evaluates builtin calls by lowering them to GCC trees and folding them back to D constant expressions, requests creation of runtime `TypeInfo` objects for `typeid`, and hands frontend object emission requests off to declaration tree building.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the d-frontend pair: it defines the frontend-to-backend callback behavior used during semantic processing and CTFE, whereas d-frontend.h is only the tiny declaration header for druntime allocator/init entry points exposed to GCC-side code.
